questions.question: Which sentence is in the past continuous tense?
options: She was reading when I called.
questions.answer: She was reading when I called.
questions.explanation: Past continuous: was/were + verb-ing, for actions in progress at a past time.

questions.question: We add '-s' to the verb when the subject is he, she, or it in simple present.
questions.explanation: Third person singular present simple: verb + s/es.

questions.question: They ___ (play) football when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: Past continuous for ongoing past action.

questions.question: Give two examples of modal verbs and how they are used.
questions.answer: Can (ability): I can swim. Must (obligation): You must study.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs express ability, necessity, possibility, etc.
